line.en: the 30th eastside culture crawl: over 500 artist studios across east vancouver, four days. thursday evenings run 17:00 to 22:00.
line.de: der 30. eastside culture crawl: über 500 künstleratelier im osten von vancouver, vier tage. donnerstagabends von 17 bis 22 uhr.
line.tr: 30. eastside culture crawl: doğu vancouver'da 500'ü aşkın sanatçı atölyesi, dört gün. perşembe akşamları 17 ile 22 arası.

sparks.why: Eastside Culture Crawl, 19 to 22 Nov 2026 in Vancouver's Eastside Arts District; Thu and Fri 17:00 to 22:00 per a Curiocity and BroadwayWorld listing. One source gives 18 to 21 Nov, which I did not use. Falls in days eight to fourteen.
